groups.saying_opens: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى
أن ينصب الطير أو الشىء فيرمى

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): the Prophet's prohibition at Khaybar (saying 1); Abu 'Asim's explanation of two terms, asked by a question, with its own transmitter «قال محمد بن يحيى» (saying 2)
«وسئل عن الخليسة» continues saying 2 with the same transmitters
«غير، واحد» is an unnamed transmitter (rule 8's kind); «وهو ابن سارية» is an editor's gloss and is left out, so «أبيها» stays a bare relation
Abu 'Asim is the answerer of saying 2 and is a link in his own place (rule 6)
